description: Turns the four sliders and eight buttons of the Slider immediately to its left into CV outputs, with a vMIDI output beside them

params.text: Chooses the span the CV outputs cover: 0-10 gives 0V to 10V, 0-5 gives 0V to 5V, and -5-5 gives -5V to +5V, and it is read by the four slider outputs alone

outputs.text: The slider of the same number on the Slider as a voltage in the span RANGE sets, slewed towards each new value in place of stepping to it
10V while the button of the same number on the Slider is pressed or latched on, and 0V otherwise
A vMIDI cable carrying the controller messages arriving from the hardware, for Kilpatrick's patchable MIDI modules rather than for a voltage input

notes: it goes immediately to the right of a Slider and puts out nothing on its own
